svg.title: Compare Sub-Niches by Delivery-Hour Yield
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-delivery-yield; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Sub-Niches by Delivery-Hour Yield; subtitle: Five fixed-scope offers expose the labor economics behind the price.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are illustrative implementation-fee USD per planned delivery hour, before labor, software, acquisition, and overhead costs. Hours include discovery, build, testing, and handoff. These are not net margins or market-rate claims.; caption: Rank only similarly bounded offers. Rework expands the denominator: a $12,000 sprint planned for 60 hours falls from $200 to $150 per hour if delivery reaches 80 hours.; stages: label: B2B support triage; value: $12,000 fee divided by 60 hours equals $200/hour; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Connect Zendesk to a client-approved knowledge source for classification and draft replies. Exclude automatic refunds and account changes; collect the fixed fee through milestone invoices.; label: Sales operations routing; value: $10,000 fee divided by 55 hours equals $181.82/hour; numeric value: 181.8181818181818; detail: Normalize HubSpot intake and suggest routing using documented account rules. Exclude purchased contact enrichment and autonomous outbound campaigns; the fee does not depend on client sales volume.; label: Accounts payable intake; value: $15,000 fee divided by 90 hours equals $166.67/hour; numeric value: 166.66666666666666; detail: Extract invoice fields and propose purchase-order matches for accounting review. Exclude bank-detail changes and payment execution; invoice principal belongs to the client, not agency revenue.; label: Internal knowledge retrieval; value: $9,000 fee divided by 60 hours equals $150/hour; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Index approved SharePoint documents with preserved access boundaries and source citations. Exclude unbounded document cleanup; test cross-user retrieval leakage before allowing employee access.; label: Contract intake assistance; value: $14,000 fee divided by 100 hours equals $140/hour; numeric value: 140.0; detail: Extract renewal dates and route documents to the client's designated reviewers. Exclude autonomous contract interpretation and signature authority; price document-format variation explicitly.

rect.title: label: B2B support triage; value: $12,000 fee divided by 60 hours equals $200/hour; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Connect Zendesk to a client-approved knowledge source for classification and draft replies. Exclude automatic refunds and account changes; collect the fixed fee through milestone invoices.

label: Sales operations routing; value: $10,000 fee divided by 55 hours equals $181.82/hour; numeric value: 181.8181818181818; detail: Normalize HubSpot intake and suggest routing using documented account rules. Exclude purchased contact enrichment and autonomous outbound campaigns; the fee does not depend on client sales volume.

label: Accounts payable intake; value: $15,000 fee divided by 90 hours equals $166.67/hour; numeric value: 166.66666666666666; detail: Extract invoice fields and propose purchase-order matches for accounting review. Exclude bank-detail changes and payment execution; invoice principal belongs to the client, not agency revenue.

label: Internal knowledge retrieval; value: $9,000 fee divided by 60 hours equals $150/hour; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Index approved SharePoint documents with preserved access boundaries and source citations. Exclude unbounded document cleanup; test cross-user retrieval leakage before allowing employee access.

label: Contract intake assistance; value: $14,000 fee divided by 100 hours equals $140/hour; numeric value: 140.0; detail: Extract renewal dates and route documents to the client's designated reviewers. Exclude autonomous contract interpretation and signature authority; price document-format variation explicitly.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are illustrative implementation-fee USD per planned delivery hour, before labor, software, acquisition, and overhead costs. Hours include discovery, build, testing, and handoff. These are not net margins or market-rate claims.
